contexts.text: Resen between Nineveh and Calah () = that they formed for themselves doctrinals of life; and by Resen are signified the false doctrinals thence... Falsities of life are here signified by Resen, of which no further mention is made in the Word. Resen was built between Nineveh and Calah, that is, between falsity from reasonings, and falsity from cupidities, which produces falsity of life. It is called the great city because it is from falsities of both the understanding and the will.
